detail.description:
Aliens are hiding in plain sight — can you spot them all?
As an elite sniper, you must rely on sharp eyes and quick instincts.
Find them. Aim. Eliminate!

🎯 Game Features
 • Detect the Disguise: Aliens transform into map objects and environmental details — stay alert!
 • Stylish Weapons: Unlock unique sniper skins and decorations to show off your battle style!
 • Diverse Maps: Explore city streets, tall buildings, small towns, and secret bases — each with new challenges!
 • Hidden Secrets: Ever
